name: unpackerr
title: Unpackerr
description: Unpacks downloads that arrive as .rar archives so Sonarr and Radarr can import them, and deletes the unpacked copy once it is imported. Without it such a download sits in the queue as 'no files found are eligible for import'. Give it the two API keys (Settings > General in each app) and the downloads folder those apps use.

variables.name: UNPACKERR_DOWNLOADS
variables.label: Downloads folder
variables.description: The folder on this server your download client saves into, mounted at /downloads (use the path Sonarr and Radarr see it at)

variables.name: UNPACKERR_SONARR_URL
variables.label: Sonarr address
variables.description: Leave as it is when Sonarr runs in the same stack

variables.name: UNPACKERR_SONARR_API_KEY
variables.label: Sonarr API key
variables.description: Sonarr > Settings > General; empty leaves Sonarr out

variables.name: UNPACKERR_RADARR_URL
variables.label: Radarr address
variables.description: Leave as it is when Radarr runs in the same stack

variables.name: UNPACKERR_RADARR_API_KEY
variables.label: Radarr API key
variables.description: Radarr > Settings > General; empty leaves Radarr out
